newsitem.title: USA: Maraven FCC to restart Tues/Wed; reformer out.
newsitem.headline: Maraven FCC to restart Tues/Wed; reformer out.

text.p: State Petroleos de Venezuela subsidiary Maraven plans to restart a downed fluid catalytic cracker at the giant Cardon refinery on Tuesday or Wednesday, a source familiar with the plant's operations said on Monday.
The refinery's reformer, which has been operating at a "minimum level," is expected to return to full operation in the second half of April, he said.

The refinery has a crude distillation capacity of 286,000 barrels per day (bpd). The cat cracking capacity of around 70,000 bpd has been completely lost since last Thursday morning because of a faulty valve.
In a separate incident, the plant's reformer has been down for two weeks and is operating at 25,000 bpd out of a normal 40,000 bpd. The stoppage was also forced by a technical problem.

Maraven has bought one cargo of high-octane gasoline to cover its customer program but is unlikely to need any more, the source said. However, some traders said Maraven appears still to be in the market.
